patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column content sections where a large, bold heading occupies the left column and descriptive text or a visual element is placed in the right column.
A clear typographic hierarchy with oversized, bold sans-serif headings for major sections and a lighter weight sans-serif for body text, creating strong visual anchors.
A high-contrast color scheme featuring a deep blue hero, a clean white content area, and a dark charcoal footer, punctuated by subtle grey text and borders.

The hero section features 3D platform icons that subtly parallax and rotate as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth and dynamism. The sticky navigation's 'Sign Up' button transforms its background and text color upon scroll.
Feature sections are introduced with a large, declarative statement on the left, followed by a more detailed explanation or visual on the right, guiding the user through the product's benefits.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a canvas-based animation system to render 3D platform icons that float and subtly rotate. These elements are then animated with CSS keyframes to create a parallax effect, moving at a different speed than the background as the user scrolls, enhancing depth.

The main navigation bar is sticky, and its primary call-to-action button dynamically changes its visual style (background and text color) using CSS transitions once the user scrolls past the initial hero section.

Content sections employ a responsive two-column grid, often with a large, impactful heading on one side and supporting details or an image placeholder on the other, maintaining readability and visual interest across different screen sizes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and small, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons and interactive elements, otherwise sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a comfortable rhythm within content blocks.

standout: The site's standout feature is its dynamic 3D hero illustration, which uses floating platform icons that subtly animate and parallax on scroll. This creates a sophisticated and engaging first impression that immediately communicates the product's multi-platform integration.
